_comment: Antigravity writes documents per session, not only a transcript: task.md, implementation_plan.md, walkthrough.md, plus freely-named ones. Measured on 78 sessions: 51 task, 49 plan, 40 walkthrough. The claim that it keeps no notes was wrong.
_tree: An empty subPath means the documents sit in the session directory itself, beside the .system_generated folder that holds the transcript.
_frontmatter: There is none. task.md opens straight on a checklist. The name of the file is the name of the document.
_sidecar: The description lives NEXT TO the file, in <name>.md.metadata.json, carrying {summary, updatedAt, userFacing}. One extra read per document; they are small, and `summary` is exactly the one-line description the list needs.
